verdict.rationale: Snowflake documents Apache Iceberg tables that use external cloud storage the customer manages. It positions them for existing data lakes 'that you cannot, or choose not to, store in Snowflake', which covers the core no-load requirement for Iceberg. The pack shows nothing for the Delta and Parquet parts of the story; the only file-ingestion evidence (Snowpipe/COPY) is about loading data, not querying it in place. Missing for 10: Delta Lake table querying, querying raw Parquet files in place (e.g. external tables), independent or hands-on corroboration of Iceberg querying.
